Summary: Master / Tenant Governance
Description: Manage the authoritative college profile, department master, program master, and non-authoritative college calendar configuration as owned by ADM02_college_profiles, ADM02_departments, ADM02_programs and ADM02_college_calendar_configuration.

Summary: Register and maintain the authoritative college profile
Description: As a College Admin, I want to create and update my college's profile, including accreditation references and address, so that the college has a single authoritative governance identity in CampXSync.
Acceptance Criteria: Given collegeCode, legalName, displayName and accreditationRefs, when I POST /api/v1/college-admin/profile, then collegeCode is validated as required/unique and accreditation references are validated | Given the college's status changes (e.g., ACTIVE to SUSPENDED), then the lifecycle transition is controlled rather than a free-form field update | Given the profile is updated, then currentVersion increments and a College ProfilesUpdated event is published

Summary: Create and retire a college department without breaking references
Description: As a College Admin, I want to create departments and prevent hard deletion when they are still referenced so that academic and administrative context linked to a department is never orphaned.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a departmentCode and headUserId, when I POST /api/v1/college-admin/departments, then headUserId must resolve through the IAM/HR context or the request is rejected | Given a department is still referenced by programs or other administrative records, when a hard delete is attempted, then it is rejected in favor of a status/effectiveTo lifecycle change | Given departments are listed via GET /api/v1/college-admin/departments, then results can be filtered by status

Summary: Create a program under an active department with an immutable published version
Description: As a Program Admin, I want to define a program associated with an active department so that program governance stays consistent with departmental structure and published program details cannot be silently changed.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a programCode, departmentId and durationYears, when I POST /api/v1/college-admin/programs, then the referenced department must be ACTIVE and durationYears must be positive | Given a program version is published, when an edit to that version is attempted, then it is rejected and a new version must be created instead | Given the program is created, then a ProgramsCreated event is published

Summary: Configure local college calendar behavior without overriding the authoritative academic calendar
Description: As a College Admin, I want to configure local calendar display and sync preferences so that platform behavior adapts to my college without ever overriding authoritative academic calendar facts owned by ACD-07.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a sourceCalendarId and localRules, when I save calendar configuration, then it references but does not duplicate or override authoritative ACD-07 calendar facts | Given an AcademicCalendarChanged event is consumed from ACD-07, then the local configuration's sync mode determines how display preferences are refreshed, without altering the authoritative source

Summary: Configuration & Governance
Description: Manage college-specific configuration defaults, feature overrides against global flags, and college-level policy rules as owned by ADM02_college_settings, ADM02_feature_overrides and ADM02_local_policies.

Summary: Configure college-specific settings with effective dating
Description: As a College Admin, I want to define college-specific configuration values so that my college can operate with defaults tailored to its needs while sensitive values remain protected.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a key/value/dataType, when I PUT /api/v1/college-admin/settings, then sensitive values are rejected unless submitted as secret references | Given GET /api/v1/college-admin/settings is called, then only the version effective as of now is returned | Given the setting changes, then a College SettingChanged event is published

Summary: Override a platform feature flag at the college level within safety limits
Description: As a College Admin, I want to override specific platform feature flags for my college so that I can tailor feature availability locally without violating platform-wide safety controls.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a flagKey and overrideValue with a reason, when I submit the override, then it is rejected if the target flag is a globally disabled safety control | Given effectiveFrom/effectiveTo are set, then the override only applies within that window and a FeatureOverrideChanged event is published

Summary: Publish an immutable college-level administrative policy
Description: As a College Admin, I want to author and publish local policy rules with required approval so that college-level governance is consistently enforced and auditable.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a policyCode and rules, when the policy is published, then the version becomes immutable and edits require a new version | Given the policy is a controlled policy type, when publication is attempted without approvedBy set, then it is rejected | Given the policy is published, then a Local PoliciesCreated/Updated event is emitted

Summary: Identity, Role & Access
Description: Manage college-scoped administrative user context, role catalog, permission catalog, role bindings and periodic access reviews as owned by ADM02_college_users, ADM02_roles, ADM02_permissions, ADM02_role_bindings and ADM02_access_reviews.

Summary: Maintain college-scoped administrative user context without storing credentials
Description: As a College Admin, I want to track administrative users scoped to my college, linked to department and employee reference, so that I can manage who has administrative context at the college level.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a userId and employeeRef, when a college user record is created, then the identity reference must resolve or the request is rejected, and no password data is stored | Given the user's departmentId changes, then the record is updated and a College UsersUpdated event is published

Summary: Define college roles with protected system roles
Description: As a College Admin, I want to define college role templates with bundled permissions so that access is granted consistently, while protected system roles cannot be unsafely deleted.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a roleCode and permissions, when a role is created, then role uniqueness and status are enforced | Given a role is marked as a protected system role, when deletion is attempted, then it is rejected

Summary: Maintain the college administration permission catalog
Description: As a College Admin, I want a stable, immutable-once-assigned permission catalog so that role definitions reference a consistent and auditable set of resource/action permissions.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a permissionCode is created, when it is later assigned to a role, then the code becomes immutable and cannot be changed | Given permissions are queried, then results can be filtered by resource and action

Summary: Grant scoped college role bindings without privilege escalation
Description: As a College Admin, I want to bind roles to college users at a specific scope (college/department/program) with an effective window so that access grants are least-privilege and time-bound.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a principalId, roleId, scopeType and scopeId, when a binding is created, then it is unique per those dimensions plus effective window | Given a binding would exceed the requester's own authorization policy, when submitted, then it is rejected as privilege escalation | Given effectiveTo passes, then the binding is no longer treated as active

Summary: Run periodic college access reviews with separation of duties
Description: As a College Admin, I want to run periodic reviews of college administrative access, with self-review prohibited where policy requires separation of duties, so that privileged access stays properly certified.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a review is due, when it is created, then reviewId is unique and dueAt is tracked | Given the reviewer is the same principal being reviewed and separation-of-duties policy applies, when a decision is submitted, then it is rejected | Given the review completes, then decision and completedAt are recorded

Summary: Operations & Imports
Description: Manage college data import jobs and their row/batch-level diagnostics as owned by ADM02_data_imports and ADM02_import_logs.

Summary: Submit a college data import job with idempotent replay
Description: As a College Admin, I want to submit bulk data import jobs (e.g., student/faculty/department data) so that large data sets can be loaded reliably, with safe replay if the same job is resubmitted.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a fileRef, entityType and mode, when I POST /api/v1/college-admin/imports, then schema-level validation runs before rows are processed | Given the same job is resubmitted with the same checksum/job key, when reprocessed, then it is recognized as an idempotent replay rather than duplicating data | Given the import completes, then a DataImportCompleted event is published

Summary: Track import job status and diagnostics
Description: As a College Admin, I want to check import job status and review row-level diagnostics so that I can fix and resubmit only the records that failed validation.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an importId, when I call GET /api/v1/college-admin/imports/{id}, then status and associated row-level logs are returned | Given a row fails validation, then the log entry records rowNo, entityKey, severity, code and message without duplicating raw source PII beyond what's needed

Summary: Reporting & Dashboards
Description: Manage saved college report definitions, execution runs, schedules, and precomputed dashboard snapshots as owned by ADM02_report_definitions, ADM02_report_runs, ADM02_report_schedules and ADM02_dashboard_snapshots.

Summary: Define an allow-listed college report
Description: As a College Admin, I want to define reusable report definitions restricted to an allow-listed query specification so that reporting cannot be used to run arbitrary, unauthorized database queries.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a reportCode, querySpec and permissions, when a report definition is created, then querySpec is validated against the allow-list and arbitrary queries are rejected | Given dataClass is set, then only principals with matching permissions can execute the report

Summary: Run an approved college report and retain execution history
Description: As a College Admin, I want to execute an approved report and retain its run history and output reference so that report access is fully auditable and reproducible.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a reportId and filters, when I call GET /api/v1/college-admin/reports/{code}, then a run record is created with requestedBy, startedAt and eventual outputRef | Given the run completes, then rowCount and completedAt are recorded and the export/report access is captured in the audit trail with a time-bound outputRef

Summary: Schedule a recurring report with authorized recipients
Description: As Management, I want to schedule a report to run on a recurring cron schedule and deliver it to authorized recipients so that stakeholders receive governance reporting automatically.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a cron expression, timezone and recipients, when a schedule is created, then each recipient's authorization to view the report is validated | Given the scheduled time arrives, when the job executes, then execution is idempotent and nextRunAt/lastRunAt are updated correctly

Summary: Maintain rebuildable dashboard snapshots for fast reads
Description: As Management, I want precomputed dashboard snapshots generated on a period basis so that dashboards load quickly without querying authoritative sources synchronously, and can be rebuilt if needed.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a dashboardCode and period, when a snapshot is generated, then metrics and sourceVersion are recorded and a Dashboard SnapshotsCreated event is published | Given the source data changes, then the snapshot remains rebuildable from authoritative/reporting sources rather than being the sole source of truth

Summary: Document Governance
Description: Manage the college governance document registry, immutable versioning, access grants and approval history as owned by ADM02_document_metadata, ADM02_document_versions, ADM02_document_permissions and ADM02_document_approvals.

Summary: Register a governance document with classification
Description: As a College Admin, I want to register college governance documents with an ownership and classification so that documents are tracked with required metadata before content is stored.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a documentType, title, ownerId and classification, when I POST /api/v1/college-admin/documents, then classification is mandatory and objectRef integrity is validated | Given the document is registered, then currentVersion is tracked and a Document MetadataCreated event is published

Summary: Version and checksum-verify published documents
Description: As a College Admin, I want each document version stored immutably with a verified checksum so that published document content cannot be altered without detection.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a new version is uploaded, when it is registered, then checksum is computed and verified against the stored object | Given a version has status PUBLISHED, when a modification is attempted, then it is rejected because published versions are immutable

Summary: Grant least-privilege, time-bound document access
Description: As a College Admin, I want to grant document-level access to specific principals with an expiry so that sensitive governance documents are shared on a least-privilege, time-bound basis.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a principalType/principalId and permission, when a grant is created, then effectiveFrom/effectiveTo are enforced | Given effectiveTo passes, then the grant is no longer honored for access decisions

Summary: Submit a document for approval and publish it immutably
Description: As a College Admin, I want to submit a document version for approval so that it becomes an immutable, published record only after an authorized approver decision.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a document version, when I POST /api/v1/college-admin/documents/{id}/submit, then an approval record is created under RBAC/ABAC-authorized approvers | Given an approval decision is recorded, when a change to that decision is attempted afterward, then it is rejected because approval state is immutable after decision | Given the decision is APPROVED, then the version becomes published/immutable and DocumentPublished/DocumentApprovalCompleted events are emitted

Summary: Approvals & Workflow
Description: Manage general college administrative approval requests and long-running college workflow runtime state as owned by ADM02_approval_requests and ADM02_workflow_instances.

Summary: Submit a general administrative approval request through a delegated approver chain
Description: As a College Admin, I want to submit administrative requests through a defined approver chain with delegation and SLA rules so that approvals are timely, traceable and cannot bypass required approvers.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a requestType, subjectType/Id and approverChain, when a request is submitted, then state starts at SUBMITTED with submittedAt captured | Given an approver delegates their step, then the delegation is recorded and SLA timers continue to apply | Given all approvers decide, then decidedAt is recorded and the final state reflects the aggregate decision

Summary: Run a college workflow with explicit timeout, retry and compensation
Description: As a College Admin, I want long-running college workflows (onboarding continuations, document approvals) tracked with explicit timeout, retry and compensation actions so that failures are handled predictably rather than leaving work in an unknown state.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a workflowType and subject, when a workflow starts, then its steps and state are tracked from startedAt to completedAt | Given a step fails, when the configured compensation action exists, then it executes rather than leaving the workflow inconsistent | Given the workflow completes, then an AdministrativeWorkflowCompleted event is published

Summary: Audit & Reliability
Description: Maintain the immutable college administrative audit trail and the transactional messaging reliability layer (idempotency, outbox, inbox, dead-letter) as owned by ADM02_audit_logs, ADM02_idempotency_records, ADM02_outbox_events, ADM02_inbox_events and ADM02_dead_letter_events.

Summary: Record an immutable, tamper-evident audit entry for college administrative actions
Description: As a College Admin, I want every privileged college administrative action to write an append-only, tamper-evident audit record so that governance actions at the college level are fully traceable.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a privileged write occurs, when it commits, then an ADM02_audit_logs record is written with actorId, action, resourceType/Id, beforeHash and afterHash | Given an audit record exists, when modification is attempted, then it is rejected because the collection is append-only and tamper-evident

Summary: Guarantee exactly-once processing of retried college admin commands
Description: As Platform Ops, I want retried college-admin commands (imports, approvals) deduplicated via idempotency keys so that resubmission never applies a business effect twice.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an idempotencyKey and operation, when replayed with an identical request hash, then the original responseRef is returned without reapplying the operation | Given the same key is replayed with a mismatched request hash, then the request is rejected as a conflicting duplicate

Summary: Publish college admin domain events transactionally via the outbox
Description: As Platform Ops, I want college-admin domain changes and events persisted in the same transaction via an outbox, preserving per-aggregate ordering, so that published events reliably reflect committed state.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a business transaction commits, when the outbox record is written, then it is written atomically in the same transaction | Given ordering matters for an aggregate, when events are published, then per-aggregate ordering is preserved | Given the publisher retries, then publication remains idempotent

Summary: Consume upstream academic/faculty events exactly once via the inbox
Description: As Platform Ops, I want events consumed from ACD-07, student/academic services and faculty/HR context deduplicated via an inbox so that redelivered upstream events never reapply their effect twice.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an eventId already processed for a consumer, when redelivered, then it is recognized as a duplicate and skipped | Given processing fails, then status and error are recorded for retry or investigation

Summary: Review and authorize replay of dead-lettered college events
Description: As Platform Ops, I want unrecoverable college-admin events routed to a restricted dead-letter store so that failures are visible for review and only replayed under controlled authorization.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an event exhausts retries, when it fails permanently, then it is written to ADM02_dead_letter_events with failureCode and retryCount | Given a replay is requested, then it requires controlled authorization and is captured in disposition and the audit trail

Summary: Register cross-module batch split/merge permission codes and grant them to Registrar
Description: As a College Admin Identity Administrator, I want BATCH_SPLIT_REQUEST, BATCH_SPLIT_APPROVE and BATCH_MERGE_APPROVE registered in the central college-scoped permission catalog and bound exclusively to the Registrar role for the approve permissions, so that ACD-04's batch split/merge approval authority is defined once, centrally, and enforced consistently — rather than each downstream microservice inventing and storing its own permission grants. This closes the gap identified during ACD-04 design: neither the ACD-04 Detailed Design Document nor its architecture diagram names an approving role, and Registrar was chosen specifically because batch merges can span two different departments while Registrar's authority is not department-scoped.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the three permission codes are registered in ADM02_permissions with a source annotation referencing ACD-04 as the enforcing service, When the Registrar role is provisioned or reviewed, Then BATCH_SPLIT_APPROVE and BATCH_MERGE_APPROVE are present in its ADM02_role_bindings grant set by default, BATCH_SPLIT_REQUEST is granted to Academic Admin instead, and no role holds both a *_REQUEST and its corresponding *_APPROVE permission simultaneously, enforcing separation of duties at the binding level.

Summary: Register a batch split/merge workflow type consuming ACD-04 approval-request events
Description: As a College Admin Workflow Administrator, I want a new college workflow type registered for batch split and merge requests, so that ACD-04 can delegate approval routing to the platform's existing Approvals & Workflow capability instead of implementing its own approve/reject state machine locally.
Acceptance Criteria: Given ACD-04 publishes a BatchSplitApprovalRequested payload (envelope: eventId, eventType, eventVersion=1.0, tenantId, institutionId, correlationId, timestamp) with data: { requestId, requestType:"SPLIT", sourceBatchId, sourceBatchCode, departmentId, campusId, requestedBy, requestedAt, reason, proposedSections:[{sectionCode, capacity, targetStudentIds[]}], approverRole:"REGISTRAR" }. or a BatchMergeApprovalRequested payload (same envelope) with data: { requestId, requestType:"MERGE", sourceBatchIds[], sourceBatchDepartmentIds[] (one per source batch, needed for the cross-department check), targetBatchId (null if a new batch is created), campusId, requestedBy, requestedAt, reason, approverRole:"REGISTRAR" }. event, When the College Admin Module's inbox consumes it (deduplicated via ADM02_inbox_events on eventId), Then an ADM02_workflow_instances record is created populated from requestId, requestType, sourceBatchId(s), departmentId(s)/sourceBatchDepartmentIds, campusId, requestedBy, requestedAt and reason, with the approver chain resolved to Registrar for the request's tenantId+institutionId scope (per the ADM02_permissions/ADM02_role_bindings grant), using the standard explicit timeout, retry and compensation semantics already used for general administrative approvals. Given the Registrar records a decision on that workflow instance, When the decision is finalized, Then ADM02 publishes a BatchSplitApprovalDecided / BatchMergeApprovalDecided payload (same envelope) with data: { requestId, decision:"APPROVED"|"REJECTED", decidedBy, decidedAt, reason }. event back to ACD-04 (matching requestId, correlationId carried through from the original request) so ACD-04 can resume or revert the split/merge without any ACD-04-owned approval endpoint being called.

Summary: Capture batch split/merge approval decisions in the cross-module audit trail
Description: As a Compliance Officer, I want the Registrar's approve/reject decision on a batch split/merge request recorded as an immutable, tamper-evident audit entry in the College Admin Module, so that this cross-department governance decision has a durable record independent of ACD-04's own batch_history, consistent with how every other administrative approval is audited.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a Registrar approves or rejects a pending batch split/merge workflow instance, When the decision is recorded, Then an ADM02_audit_logs entry is written capturing actorId, decision, reason, timestamp and the source ACD-04 batchId(s), the entry can never be updated or deleted, and the corresponding inbound event from ACD-04 is deduplicated via ADM02_inbox_events so a redelivered event never produces a duplicate audit entry.
